book.name: Yohane
book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na Yohane Yohane

content: Yesu kanguabwitukila ahundwa bhake saba
Mbole ya agho, Yesu kakiabwitukila kangi ahundwa bhake mu mbwegha ya lihibha Tibelia. Habhu ndo muyibheghite.
Simoni Petili na Tomasi ywakakemitwe Pacha, na Natanaeli nkolannima ghwa kitami kya Kana ya ku Galilaya, na bhana abhili bha Sebedayu na ahundwa bhake abhili bhakibhegha bhoha papamu.

Simoni Petili kakiaghombela ayake, “Nenga nungughenda kughomeha homba.” Nabho bhakinng'ombela, “Twaalongohana papamu na ghwenga,” Hino bhakighenda bhakiyingila mu bhwato, peni pakilo bhakimokola ng'obhe kyohele.
Malabhila putiputi, Yesu kakiyima mu mbwegha ya lihibha, peni ahundwa bhake bhakimmanya ng'obhe kukita kakibhegha Yesu.
Mbole, Yesu kakiakonya, “Maaghanja bhangu ng'omeha ng'obhe hata na homba yumu?” Bhombe bhakinnyanga, “Kahone kilibhi.”

Yesu kakiaghombela, “Muyitaghe njaho yenu ku nnilo ghwa bhwato ghwenu na mwenga maaghomeha homba.” Hino bhakitagha njaho peni hino bakihotola ng'obhe kukwakwaha njaho mu bhwato kubhukana na uyoloho ghwa homba.
Yula nhundwa ywakapalitwe na Yesu kakinng'ombela Petili, “Ayu ndo Bambo!” Naywo Simoni Petili pakayihwite kukita ndo Bambo, kakihwala lipinda lyake kiyaha kakibhegha uhula, na kakilitagha mumachi.
Peni bhala ahundwa bhangi bakihika kwa bhwato kunu paakwakaha njaho yabhe yiimemiteghe homba, bhakibhegha ng'obhe kutali na luhingu ngati bhakibhegha utali ghwa mita hamsini kumi kuhuma ku lukingo.
Hino paahikite kuluhingo bhakibhona mwoto ghwa makala ghukolehwa kala na unani mwake pakibhikwa homba na mangate.
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mubhayeghe apa amoo homba bhamubhaghomehite hinu.”

Simoni Petili kakiyingila mu bhwato na kakikwakaha yila njaho yiimemite homba mbaka kuluhingo, na mu njaho ahyo bhakibhegha homba mia na hamsini na tatu. Hata payibhele homba bhakimema muno, peni yila njaho yikikakuka ng'obhe.
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nhiki tulyeghe.” Kahone na yumoo yumu ywabhe ywakayighite kunkonya, “Ghu ghani ghwenga?” Kiyaha bhakimanya kukita kakibhegha Bambo.
Yesu kakihika kakitola lila lingate, kakiapegha, kakitenda ubhwabhu abhu na kwa bhala homba.
Ayi yikibhegha pandatu Yesu kuabwitukila ahundwa bhake mbole ya kuhyuka.
Yesu kanguyobhela na Petili

Pabhayomolite kulyegha, Yesu kakinkonya Simoni Petili, “Bhuli, Simoni mwana ywa Yohane, ghwenga ghungumbala kupitingana abha?” Naywo kakinnyanga, “Ena Bambo, ghwenga ghungumanya kukita nungughupala.” Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ghubhalele mene bhangu.”

Yesu kakinkonya kangi paubhili, “Simoni mwana ywa Yohane, bhuli ghungumbala hoto?” Petili kakinnyanga, “Ena Bambo ghwenga ghungumanya kukita nungughupala.” Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ghubhalele mene bhangu.”

Yesu kakinkonya kangi paundatu, “Simoni mwana ywa Yohane, ghungumbala hoto?” Apa Petili kakibhaghaya kiyaha kakinkonya paundatu, “Bhuli ghungumbala?” Petili kakinng'ombela, “Bambo ghwenga ghungumanya ghoha, ghungumanya kukita nungughupala!” Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ghubhalele mene bhangu.

Kulyaghila nungughughombela, paghubheghite nhongolo ghukihyobhelela kuhwala lukungi na kughenda kwoheli kughukupalite, peni paghubhegha nng'ohi ghwagholoha mabhoko ghako na mundu yungi kataghuhwaliha na kughuyegha kwanga kughupala ghwenga.”
Yesu Kakilongela habhu, pakalaha bhula kiho kyoki mukipala kuyegha ukulu ghwa Chapanga. Mbole kakinng'ombela, “Ghundughile!”
Yesu na yula nhundwa yungi
Petili kakikilibhuka na kakimmona yula nhundwa yungi, ywakapalitwe na Yesu, ndo aywo ywakayeghamite mu kihubha kya Yesu pa mulyo ghwa makimuhi, kakinkonya Yesu, “Bambo ghani ywakapala kughukiluka?”
Ndo Petili kakimmona aywo nhundwa, kakinkonya Yesu, “Bambo, bhuli mundu ayu?”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Handa pambala kalame mbaka pambala kubhuya, ayo yabhegha na ningo yoke kwa ghwenga? Gwenga ghundughile nenga!”

Hino, nhalo aghu ghukitapakala mu nkati ya alongo kukita nhundwa aywo katahwegha ng'obhe. Peni Yesu kakilongela ng'obhe kukita katahwegha, ngati kakilongela, “Handa pambala kalame mbaka panonda kubhuya, ayi yabhegha na fwambulo yoki kwa ghwenga?”
Aywo ndo yula nhundwa ywakalubhulilite agha, na ywakatyekite milando ayi, na tungumanya kukita uyimiho ghwake ndo ghwa hoto.
Uhiko
Yibhegha milando yingi mitangalo yakatendite Yesu, ghene handa yingatyekitwe hyoha yimu mbole ya yimu, nunguhwacha kukita nnima ghwoha ghungakwilite ng'obhe pakubhika hitabho hyene hingatyekitwe.
